A '''bounty hunter''' was a member of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild]] in the years following the [[Galactic Civil War]] and during the early days of the [[New Republic]]. A hulking, brutal hunter, he was present during the shootout on the planet of [[Nevarro]] when the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]] attempted to escape with [[Din Grogu|the Child]]. He fought side-by-side with guild leader [[Greef Karga]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You put the bounty down and perhaps I'll let you pass.|Greef Karga|<ref name="Chapter 3">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 3: The Sin}}</ref>}}
[[File:HoldTheLine-TMCh3.png|thumb|left|270px|The hunter stood beside Greef Karga to apprehend Din Djarin.]]
The bounty hunter was present in the [[Nevarro school|Nevarro cantina]] when Din Djarin returned from the planet [[Pagodon]]. He eyed Djarin as he turned his multiple [[Holopuck|bounty pucks]] into [[Greef Karga]].<ref name="Chapter 1">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 1: The Mandalorian}}</ref>

Some time later, he joined Karga and the rest of the guild members as they attempted to stop Djarin from fleeing the planet. The bounty hunter stood beside Karga while he attempted to persuade Djarin to hand over The Child. The Bounty Hunter had his larger blaster aimed directly at the Mandalorian during the conversation. He engaged in a firefight with Djarin,<ref name="Chapter 3" /> but was ultimately gunned down by more [[Mandalorian]]s that arrived to aide Djarin.<ref name="Comic 3">[[The Mandalorian 3|''The Mandalorian'' 3]]</ref>

==Equipment==
The bounty hunter carried a large [[blaster rifle]] and wore large, protective [[gauntlet]]s on his [[Limb|hands]] and arms. He also donned a flowing dark [[robe]], heavy [[Combat boots/Canon|combat boots]], and a [[breath mask]].<ref name="Chapter 3" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:GekkoBountyHunter4.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The bounty hunter, as shown on an Instagram post by Brian Sipe]]
The bounty hunter first appeared in [[Chapter 1: The Mandalorian|Chapter 1]] of [[Jon Favreau]]'s television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', directed by [[Dave Filoni]]<ref name="Chapter 1" /> and first aired [[November 12]], [[2019]].<ref name="Episode Amount">{{WebCite|url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/heat-vision/star-wars-new-mandalorian-details-footage-unveiled-1201931|text='The Mandalorian': Jon Favreau Teases Disney+ Series at Star Wars Celebration|author=Aaron Couch & Graeme McMillan|date=2018-12-10|archivedate=20191109001233}}</ref> The character was portrayed by American actor [[Dominic Pace]] and the name Gekko was given to the bounty hunter by make up artist [[Brian Sipe]] in an [[Wikipedia:Instagram|Instagram]] post.<ref name="Sipe post">{{Instagram|username=briansipemakeup|url=p/CCAaT2fgnI4|name=Brian Sipe|date=2020-06-29|archiveurl=https://archive.is/pChja}}</ref> In [[November]] of [[2020]], the bounty hunter received a sketch art card by [[Topps|The Topps Company]].<ref>{{Instagram|username=jaymanchandart|url=p/CHLGE11gBAs|name=Jay Manchand|date=11-4-2020|quote=My officially licensed @starwars hand painted art card from @topps The Mandalorian Series 1. Depicting the character 'Gekko', portrayed by @dominicpace1 - this original card is inserted into a random pack.|archiveurl=https://archive.vn/ilfTB|nobackup=1|link=https://www.instagram.com/p/CHLGE11gBAs}}</ref>
